# Primary-host workflow v3 acceptance fixture

On 2026-10-13 (America/Los_Angeles), the primary coding agent used the compiled
Canvas Agent CLI outside its checkout with a newly created synthetic workspace.
It read the actual prep/draft handoffs, authored these candidates, executed five
calculations, completed both tasks and inspected source currentness and XLSX cells.
The candidates below are retained outputs from that exercise, not dynamically
generated content or an independent reviewer/model run. Task IDs are replaced
with `{{TASK_ID}}` for replay; all readings and policy are invented fixture text.

The first setup placed policy at an unsupported filename and consequently had no
guidance in its tasks. The host stopped, placed it at the supported active location
`guidance/prep-guidance.md`, and created fresh tasks with the policy captured.
It also corrected a rejected three-input `add` request to `sum`. Neither fix edited
saved task records or bypassed a validator. This is useful usability evidence,
not a claim those initial fixture mistakes were product defects.

`test/host-v3-acceptance.test.ts` replays setup, explicit source selection, both
v3 handoffs, five calculations, completion, inspection and automatic XLSX creation
through the compiled CLI. It checks exact source preservation, the completed
candidate bytes, source-currentness and numeric cell values. Replay verifies
mechanics and compatibility of these retained artifacts; it does not invoke a
model or independently grade reasoning, citations, permission or business impact.

Observed scenario calculations: 500 × 40 = 20000; 150 × 12 = 1800;
100 × 3 = 300; sum(1800, -300, -1000) = 500; 20000 + 500 = 20500.
The already-paid 2000 study fee is excluded from incremental costs. Real demand,
operating costs, test precision and commercial success remain unknown.

No live Canvas account, student vault, installed-plugin activation, submission,
approval, cloud upload, hidden model call or human PASS verdict was used.

## Scoped guidance and custom-format follow-up

The primary host repeated the compiled external-checkout exercise on 2026-10-13
in `/tmp/canvas-host-scoped-M3HwSJ`. It initialized the explicit assignment starter,
added invented student preferences and ordered Recommendation/Computations/
Limitations/Sources headings, and supplied an unrelated policy-restricted guide.
It read the fresh task handoff, checked the fixture's explicit AI permission,
executed the five calculations and authored `custom-candidate.md` in that format.
The retained artifact answers all three prompt requests, distinguishes the sunk
fee, applies both readings and labels missing empirical inputs. Its uncertainty
decision rule is explicitly a host proposal, not claimed instructor policy.
Completion and inspection passed with an automatic XLSX companion.

The added compiled replay test creates the starter, preserves edited preferences
on retry, checks scoped/custom guidance and sources, executes arithmetic, saves
the retained candidate and checks exact record/output/workbook preservation across
fresh CLI processes and identical completion retries. It verifies the 500 and
20500 worksheet cells. This is recovery from disk, not surviving subagents or a
test of Codex's `/goal` controller. No student approval is manufactured.

The observed handoff had empty questions and `deliverable.kind: none` for the
prompt's imperative-only list introduced by “answer these questions”. The host
therefore used the complete source prompt, not an assumed exhaustive checklist.
That was the detector behavior at the time of the exercise; structural acceptance
does not prove prompt coverage. This follow-up verifies one ordinary custom-format scenario,
not numeric multipart scope, every new frozen recipe, independent academic quality,
real coursework or installed-plugin behavior.

Fresh tasks now use deliverable parser v2, which detects that directive and ends
the final item before a separately line-labeled Rubric section. The replay adapts
the retained answers into the exact detected headings, separating the baseline
answer and citation where needed. Original candidates remain unchanged. This
reorganization is not a new model run or independent academic grade; older saved
recipes keep their original detection behavior and historical artifact bytes.
